evals.name: grounded-feature-launch
evals.prompt: Create a portrait launch video for OrbitOps. We just shipped incident handoffs that cut onboarding a new responder from 45 minutes to 4 minutes. 320 teams used the beta. The product now bundles the timeline, owner, and next action in one handoff. Use only these facts; there are no screenshots or customer quotes.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded launch VideoConfig, clean validation, contact sheet, and Studio handoff command. No full MP4 and no invented proof.
expectations: The run creates video-brief.md and video.json.
The agent uses the bundled template catalog and inspects exact schemas.
video.json validates with zero errors and zero warnings as format launch.
The run creates a contact sheet and does not render an MP4.
Every numeric proof used by a proof template comes from the prompt.
The final response hands video.json to the user with a vanillasky studio command without launching Studio.

evals.name: exact-customer-review
evals.prompt: Make a portrait customer review video for Relay. Exact quote: 'Relay cut our weekly reporting from three hours to twelve minutes, and the board finally trusts the numbers.' — Maya Chen, COO at Northstar. Do not add ratings, customer counts, or performance claims that are not in this prompt.
evals.expected_output: A review VideoConfig that preserves the supplied quote and attribution, validates cleanly, and is inspected as a contact sheet before Studio handoff.
expectations: The run creates video-brief.md and video.json.
The agent uses the bundled template catalog and inspects exact schemas.
video.json validates with zero errors and zero warnings as format review.
The run creates a contact sheet and does not render an MP4.
The supplied quote and attribution are preserved without invented ratings or proof.
The final response hands video.json to the user with a vanillasky studio command without launching Studio.
